name: workflow-loop
description: A `nodetool.control.Loop` whose body feeds `next` and `condition` back into the Loop, the only cycle a graph may contain (docs/workflow-loops.md). The body appends one character per pass and asks for another pass while the text is shorter than four characters, so the run ends on the condition, not on `max_iterations`, and `done` delivers "abab". Pins the Loop actor's iteration, termination and EOS handling (packages/kernel/src/loop.ts) and the cycle check in correlation analysis on the kernel and the ws-server.
